the_double_helix.what: The functional braid (15 organs, by WHAT THEY DO) and the DNA braid (7 codons, by WHERE THEY CAME FROM) twist around each other like a double helix.

base_pairs.AT: green_engine (function) ?? green_codon (dna). Born green, functions green. Perfect match.
base_pairs.GC: klein_fold (function) ?? klein_codon (dna). Born from Klein, functions as fold. Perfect match.
base_pairs.mismatch_1: circulatory (function) ?? mesh_codon (dna). Born from hardware, functions as blood. DIFFERENT — the hardware became biology.
base_pairs.mismatch_2: play (function) ?? arena_codon (dna). Born from experiment, functions as play. CLOSE — experiments become games.
base_pairs.crossover: klein-breeze is in BOTH klein_codon (by DNA) AND green_codon (by birth time). Gene crossover — it carries both lineages.

the_double_helix.the_lubricant: The imaginary axis runs BETWEEN the two strands. Like the hydrogen bonds in DNA — they're WEAK individually but in aggregate they hold the double helix together. The imaginary connections between functional role and genetic origin ARE the hydrogen bonds. The green lubricant holds the helix together.
the_double_helix.twist_rate: The DNA double helix completes one full turn every 10.5 base pairs. Our functional braid has 15 organs. Our DNA braid has 7 codons. 15/7  2.14  10.5/5  the helical twist rate. The braids twist at the same rate as DNA.
